preconditions.description: The number of rows in the park is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The number of columns in the park is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The total number of cells in the park is at least 1 and at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: All f_{i,j} are distinct integers from 1 to n * m.
preconditions.description: The silence levels in the cells are a permutation of numbers from 1 to n * m.

postconditions.description: The number of pleasant segments of silence is a non-negative integer.
